description: Rothco’s Canvas Assualt Cargo Bag is designed for maximum durability and versatility, making it an essential accessory for carrying your gear. Constructed from heavyweight cotton canvas and webbing material, this duffle bag is built to withstand tough conditions while providing reliable performance. The bag features 2 large open-top side pockets for quick access to your EDC essentials. The detachable and adjustable shoulder strap extents up to 51 inches, ensuring comfortable and customizable carrying options. The unwashed and water-resistant canvas material keeps your tactical supplies protected from the elements. Additionally, the brass-plated hardware adds a touch of rugged elegance to the bag. Measuring 29 inch x 14.5 inch x 13.5 inch, this spacious cargo bag provides ample storage for all your needs, whether for travel, work, or outdoor activities. With its durable construction and practical design, Rothco’s Canvas Assault Cargo Bag is your go-to choice for reliable and stylish gear transport. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
